newsitem.title: FRANCE: Investment bank upgrades Canal Plus.
newsitem.headline: Investment bank upgrades Canal Plus.

text.p: British investment banker Kleinwort Benson said on Thursday it had upgraded its rating on French pay television firm Canal Plus to "hold" from "sell" after its shares hit a year low of 992 francs.

"I recommend that longterm investors hold on to their shares but for the short term one must remain cautious," Kleinwort Benson's Laurent Saglio told Reuters. "It's a good idea to accumulate Canal shares, buying them as they fall."
Canal Plus shares were down 0.59 percent to 1,004 francs at 1228 GMT.
